items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I put her on the records.

ctx.x: That must have been where she died. Her daughter had talked to Google down there. And she'd been there, Tennessee. Her daughter had talked to Google down there. I didn't really know her. I heard her a couple of times. I know I put her on the records. I heard her, of course, on all your records. I put her on the records.
I put her on the records. I put her on the records.

I put them on the records. I put them on the records. I have her records, but I never got to meet her or see her or hear her in person. Well, she died. She was great. But she was from Georgia. She was from Columbus.
